jobs.description: Build Europe's semiconductor future with us!Join us during the exciting build-up phase of one of Europe’s most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites. As an MQR Technician at ESMC in Dresden, you play a central role in ensuring operational quality, accurate documentation, and process reliability. You bridge the gap between cleanroom operations, quality data analysis, and document management. In close collaboration with our engineering teams and international counterparts at TSMC HQ, you ensure that quality standards, offline calibration, and statistical process controls run smoothly from day one.Job Responsibilities• Quality Data & Reporting: Support engineers by preparing preliminary reports, tracking SPC (Statistical Process Control) charts, and gathering data for Cpk and process health indices.• Document Control Management: Create, review, update, and archive quality- and production-related documents in compliance with international semiconductor standards.• Offline Calibration & Tool Management: Coordinate recalls, maintain calibration records, audit calibration status labels, and interface with external third-party calibration vendors.• Wafer Logistics & Cross-Fab Collaboration: Coordinate wafer shipments between ESMC and Taiwan fabs for qualification, testing, and quality defense.• Metrology & Tool Matching Support: Assist engineers with metrology tool gating, tool matching activities, and quality verification tasks.• Audit & Discrepancy Checks: Conduct regular checks on quality documents and system entries to detect and resolve discrepancies early.• Knowledge Transfer: Train junior team members and provide first-level support to internal users regarding the document management system.Your profile Must Have• Completed 3-year vocational training (e.g., as a Chemical Laboratory Technician / Chemielaborant, CTA, PTA, Physics Technician, or a comparable technical/scientific background).• Up to 3 years of professional experience in an office, manufacturing, or laboratory environment.• Solid computer literacy, including intermediate skills in Microsoft Office (especially MS Excel for data evaluation).• Structured, detail-oriented working style with the ability to handle multiple priorities in a dynamic operations environment.• Willingness to complete a ~6-month hands-on training program in Taiwan during your onboarding to build core competencies and an international network.• Fluent English skills (written and spoken); basic German communication skills.Nice to Have• Initial experience in the semiconductor, pharmaceutical, medical device, or other highly regulated industries.• Familiarity with Document Control Systems, calibration management, or basic SPC concepts.• Advanced Excel skills (Formulas, Macros/VBA) or initial exposure to SQL.• Basic knowledge of Mandarin is an asset.Reasons to join ESMC• Security & Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs.• Company Pension Plan & Financial Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).• Relocation Support for Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide you with all the support you will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden.• Training & Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center, gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved in operating complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training, while you continuously expand your knowledge.• Health & Well-Being: An annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit.• Meals & Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket).Application documentsPlease apply with your English CV.About usEach journey starts with a first step.Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden, boost your career and put your true potential to the test. You will be working in a fast paced, international startup environment whilst at the same time having access to the experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. You have ample opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital Transformation, and various advanced Facilities related topics, both in Taiwan and other sites around the world.Behind the world’s most advanced technology are real people with real passion. Our success is fueled by our core values: Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust (ICIC).We create a work environment that promotes diversity, ignites passion and enables you to reach your full potential.At ESMC, we welcome applications from all people, regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age or sexual identity.

Hi there!“Make the world a healthier place” – that’s our mission at Data4Life. Our IT Operations team plays a central role in it: we make sure our colleagues can always rely on secure, efficient digital tools and a well-functioning workplace infrastructure. This lets our teams across the organization focus fully on their contribution to healthcare in Germany and beyond.To strengthen our IT Operations team, we are looking for you as an IT Support Specialist (f/m/x). You report directly to our Head of IT Operations and are responsible for our entire helpdesk infrastructure. In short: Nothing works without you.Your future role• You are the first point of contact for all internal IT matters and support our growing team at our locations in Berlin and Potsdam. You also set up the technical equipment for new colleagues in Singapore during onboarding• You own end-user support : you resolve hardware, software, and access requests independently and continuously improve the user experience• You maintain our identity and access management in Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, including single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, and conditional access. With Microsoft Intune, you ensure secure endpoint management• You manage our Atlassian environment (Jira and Confluence) and support teams with new projects, workflows, users, and permissions• You own our asset management end to end : from planning and procurement through the entire lifecycle to efficient onboarding setups• You proactively improve processes, documentation, and automation so that our IT stays efficient and scalableWhat you need to succeed You’re a perfect match if you bring the following:• At least 3 years of professional experience in IT support, IT operations, or a comparable role• Very good knowledge of macOS and Windows systems as well as common hardware, peripherals, and basic networking and troubleshooting• Good knowledge of mobile device management (MDM)• Hands-on experience with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365• A proactive, solution-oriented way of working and a passion for problem-solving• You enjoy driving topics forward on your own and being a reliable on-site IT contact: at least 4 days a week in Berlin , occasionally also in Potsdam• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics clearly and patiently• Fluent English (our company language) and German at B2/C1 level for day-to-day workNice To Haves are:• Good knowledge of core IT infrastructure topics such as Ubiquiti network, VMs, VMware etc.• Certifications or experience in IT security and in implementing technical security measuresYou don’t meet every requirement 100 percent? Apply anyway. What matters to us is that you’re motivated to learn new things and help shape our IT.Why you will love working with us• Impact everyone feelsYour work keeps our teams running smoothly. With a stable, secure, and modern IT environment, you lay the foundation for research and product development, with a long-term perspective thanks to the Hasso Plattner Foundation.• More than classic IT supportYou’ll work on IT infrastructure, modern workplace, AI, and a wide range of tools. Depending on your experience and interests, you could also grow into DevOps topics, for example.• Small team, lots of room to shape thingsYou take on responsibility early and actively help shape processes, tools, and standards. Your ideas directly improve the day-to-day work of all your colleagues.• Learn and growWith your training budget, you can develop your skills in a targeted way, for example through training courses, certifications, conferences, or professional literature on new tools and AI. In regular development conversations, you plan your next steps together with your manager. And alongside your day-to-day work, you’ll have time to learn.• Team and office cultureWe work with sensitive health data. That’s why trust, honesty, and reliability are especially important to us, both in how we handle data and in how we work together.• An attractive overall packagePermanent contract, 30 vacation days, flexible working hours, a clear overtime policy, Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass), company health insurance, support with your company pension plan, and much more.• Competitive salaryDepending on your experience, we offer between EUR 50,000 and EUR 65,000 gross per year.Good to knowWe especially welcome applications from members of the LGBTQI+ community, people with a migration background, People of Color, and people with disabilities or chronic illnesses.If you need support or accommodations during the application process or interviews because of a disability, please let us know and we’ll do our best to accommodate you.Please include complete application documents (CV, references, and your earliest possible start date). Any questions? Your contact person for this position is Jiyoung Ryu (she/her) .About usData4Life is a nonprofit organization with the vision of making the world a healthier place. With an international team, we work together on the mission to digitize health research. By linking technology and research, we make health data available to research in a comprehensive, digital and secure way. Our interdisciplinary team in Potsdam, Berlin and Singapore brings together experts from fields such as product development, digital engineering, data security and science. Data4Life was founded in 2017 and is funded by the Hasso Plattner Foundation. We care about Diversity : Many different lives, careers, and development paths lead to Data4Life. We welcome experts from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to our international team, offering everyone equal opportunities to be themselves and develop to the best of their abilities. Diversity, equality, and inclusion are not just nice words at Data4Life – we put them into practice in all of our activities and projects, striving to incorporate

jobs.description: Jetzt bewerben(Senior) Platform Engineer (f/m/d) at SAP LinuxLabDatum: 17.11.2026Unternehmen: SAPWe help the world run betterAt SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.What you’ll buildAs part of the SAP LinuxLab, you will help advance Linux as a key platform for SAP solutions. Your work ensures that SAP products run reliable and efficiently across physical hardware, virtualized environments, and leading cloud providers.In this role, you will:- Test and certify physical hardware, virtual machines, Linux distributions, Linux software, cloud providers and cloud products.- Install and validate Linux and SAP products on both physical servers and cloud environments.- Collaborate with Linux partners and internal SAP teams to evaluate new developments and test upcoming technologies.- Support the continuous improvement of SAP on Linux by contributing ideas, identifying optimization opportunities, and validating new approaches.- Work with modern cloud focused technologies as SAP continues its cloud transformation.- Provide Linux development support for customers and SAP cloud operation teamsWhat you bringYou are a collaborative team player with a strong enthusiasm for Linux as an operating system, and you bring:- A master’s degree in computer science or natural science (or equivalent technical experience)- Knowledge or hands-on skills in one or more of the following areas:- Linux distributions, applications and tools- Linux administration and shell scripts- Development skills in C/C++, Python, ABAP, Rust, Go or similar languages are beneficial- Processor architectures like x86-64, aarch64, ppc64 and others- CI/CD pipeline design and implementation (GitHub Actions, Jenkins)- Container expertise (Docker image creation, multi-stage builds, registry management)- Kubernetes deployment and orchestration (manifests, Helm charts, operators)- Experience in Linux Kernel Virtual Machine or other hypervisor technologies- Linux security tools (e.g. SELinux)- SAP applications and SAP system administration- Fluent German and EnglishWhere you belongAt the SAP LinuxLab, you will join a highly skilled engineering team dedicated to ensuring SAP runs best on Linux across environments. We value collaboration, curiosity, hands on experimentation, and a passion for open source technologies.You will thrive here if you enjoy technically deep work, diverse testing scenarios, and partnering with internal and external Linux experts in a fast evolving cloud and platform landscape.#SAPABAPCareersBring out your bestSAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.We win with inclusionSAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Mechanobiology & Digital Twins (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: - The Institute of Active Polymers at Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon is seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher in Mechanobiology & Digital Twins for its activities in the field of stem cell modification and biomaterials at its Teltow site. The position is initially limited until 30 November 2028.Equal opportunity is an integral part of our personnel policy. The full-time position (39 hours per week) can, in principle, also be filled on a part-time basis.Your tasks:Scientific and methodological tasks:- design and perform mechanobiology experiments with primary T cells, B cells and/or other immune cells at engineered biomaterial interfaces- develop, optimize and apply advanced fluorescence and super-resolution microscopy to resolve receptor organization, close-contact formation, cytoskeletal architecture and signalling in living and fixed cells- establish and use biomaterial model systems, including nanostructured surfaces, hydrogels/​​viscoelastic materials and functionalized interfaces with controlled mechanics, topography and ligand presentation- build quantitative image-analysis workflows for large 2D/3D/4D microscopy data sets and extract spatial, dynamic and biophysical features at the single-cell and subcellular level- integrate imaging, mechanical and functional measurements into digital-twin models of immune-cell activation and cell-material interactions- develop, fit and validate mechanistic and data-driven models (e.g. ODE, agent-based, biophysical, statistical or machine-learning approaches as appropriate), including parameter inference and sensitivity analysis- use an iterative model-experiment cycle to generate testable predictions and experimentally validate and refine the digital twins- quantify immune-cell activation, signalling, morphology and function using complementary cellbiological and biophysical assays, including flow cytometry and live-cell measurements- cooperate closely with microscopy, materials-science, computational and immunology partners and contribute to shared experimental and data standards- prepare scientific publications, conference contributions, invention disclosures where relevant, and contribute to follow-up funding and grant applications- supervise MSc students and interns and contribute to the scientific mentoring of PhD studentsRelated tasks:- literature and data analysis in the relevant fields; documentation and reproducible/​FAIR management of imaging, analysis and modelling workflows- procurement of materials and consumables; participation in group, institute and project meetings, partner meetings, trainings and scientific networking activities- preparation and maintenance of experimental protocols, analysis code, model documentation, progress reports and training materialsYour profile:Education:- Doctoral degree (PhD/Dr.) in biophysics, physics, bioengineering/​biomedical engineering, materials science/​biomaterials, cell biology, immunology or a comparable fieldExpertise and experience:- strong hands-on expertise in at least one of the following areas: advanced fluorescence/​superresolution microscopy, quantitative bioimaging, mechanobiology or biomaterials; demonstrated ability and motivation to expand into the adjacent areas- experience with mammalian cell culture; experience with primary immune cells and immune-cell assays is highly desirable- experience with SMLM, SIM, STED, light-sheet or comparable advanced microscopy methods is desirable- knowledge of cell-material interfaces, hydrogels, nanostructured surfaces and/or mechano­transduction is advantageous- strong quantitative image-analysis skills and scientific programming experience (e.g. Python, MATLAB or R; Fiji/​lmageJ or comparable tools)- experience with mathematical modelling, machine learning or digital-twin approaches is an advantage; a strong interest in integrating experiments with predictive models is expected- demonstrated capacity for independent scientific work, publication of research results, interdisciplinary teamwork and clear scientific communication in EnglishOur offer:- an exciting and varied job in a research center with around 1,000 employees from more than 60 nations- an International Welcome Office with guest accommodation- 6 weeks holiday per year; company holidays between Christmas and New Year's Day- social benefits under the collective agreement for the German public sector and remuneration up to pay grade 13 (EntgO Bund)- very good work-life balance; options for mobile and flexible working- a well-connected research campus, good networking opportunities, a subsidized Deutschlandticket (job ticket) subject to certain conditions- individual opportunities for training and development- an excellent technical infrastructure and modern workplace equipment- a family-friendly working environment with childcare options, e.g. a parent-child room- workplace health promotion programmes, e.g. an Employee Assistance Program (EAP)- corporate BenefitsSchwerbehinderte und diesen gleichgestellte behinderte Personen werden bei gleicher Qualifikation und Eignung im Rahmen der gesetzlichen Bestimmungen bevorzugt berücksichtigt.Bitte bewerben Sie sich mit Ihrem vollständigen Bewerbungsprofil (Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, sonstige Referenzen) über unsere Karriereseite.

5 PhD positions in immunology, infection biology and parasitologyThe International Max Planck Research School for Infectious Diseases and Immunology (IMPRS-IDI) invites applications for up to 5 fully funded PhD positions starting in 2027.We welcome highly motivated candidates to join our international and interdisciplinary research community and pursue exciting research projects in infection biology and immunology. Successful applicants will conduct their doctoral research at leading Berlin research institutions, including the Max Planck Institute for Infection Biology, German Rheumatology Research Center (DRFZ) and Charité-Universitätsmedizin Berlin.Immune-Metabolic Adaptation in Pregnancy: Implications for Offspring Health (Diefenbach lab)Molecular mechanisms of innate immune recognition (Hornung lab)How P. falciparum diversity shapes mosquito colonization strategies of malaria parasites and efficacy of transmission-blocking interventions (Levashina lab)Dissecting the Molecular Pathways of NK Cell Clonality (Romagnani lab)Epigenetic heterogeneity as a determinant of macrophage potential (Weiss lab)The IMPRS-IDI is an established international doctoral program with approximately 65 doctoral researchers from more than 25 different countries. Our mission is to support doctoral researchers in becoming creative, critical, responsible and self-confident scientists.Creative, highly motivated candidates of all nationalities with a strong commitment to researchApplicants with a strong background in molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology or related disciplines, and practical research experience relevant to their chosen project. Some projects also seek candidates with strong quantitative skillset, please check the individual project descriptions.Candidates with a strong academic record and a relevant Master’s degree (M.Sc. or equivalent). Applicants who have not yet graduated may apply, provided they complete their degree before starting their PhD.Applicants with good written and spoken English skills, German proficiency is not required.cutting-edge research opportunities and access to state-of-the-art facilitiesan excellent scientific network of internationally recognized researchersa structured doctoral program with individual supervision, a project-adapted curriculum and training in scientific, technical and transferable skillsopportunities to attend conferences and present your research internationallya supportive, international PhD community and a stimulating, multi-disciplinary research environment in Berlin

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionJoin our Medicinal Chemistry Department and help us explore the full potential of NMR in drug discovery.As an NMR Specialist, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, providing structural insights into protein-ligand complexes and supporting projects with NMR-based screening data. Using our state-of-the-art facilities, you will have the opportunity to develop and apply innovative NMR approaches and contribute directly to advancing our drug discovery projects.We are looking for someone who combines scientific curiosity with agility, accountability and an entrepreneurial mindset, and who enjoys working collaboratively to turn new ideas into meaningful scientific impact.Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.comThis position is limited for 2 years.Postdoc: This Position is limited for 2 years.To make it easier to find our job advertisements, we use the usual designation "postdoc". Of course, this advertisement is not only addressed to applicants directly after completing their doctorate, but to all qualified candidates.Tasks & responsibilities- One of your key tasks will be to explore and implement NMR experiments and technologies to develop an infrastructure capable of fast and robust NMR protein and protein ligand co-structure determination by combining traditional strategies with modern AI tools- Moreover, you will apply state-of-the-art NMR experiments to enable integral membrane proteins to characterize binding events, conformational changes and dynamics- In addition, you will increase speed of resonance assignment by automation of processes and software packages such as NMRtist- Furthermore, you will conduct protein- and ligand-detected Fragment Based screening by NMR, optimize automated analysis workflows and provide validated hits to project teams- You will also provide hands-on support in maintaining NMR and lab equipment infrastructure- You will have the opportunity to work together with protein scientists to express and purify isotopically labeled proteinsRequirements- You have a Ph.D. degree in Biochemistry, Structural Biology, or Biophysics or a related area with a strong background in Protein NMR spectroscopy- You have a thorough understanding of NMR structure determination and are keen to study and compare a variety of NMR methods and build an optimized infrastructure- You have proven your skills in publications and presentations- You are experienced in cloning and expressing labeled protein targets including selective labeling- You can work independently, plan, organize, troubleshoot, present work and show innovative thinking in multidisciplinary teams- You are well organized, and have strong interpersonal and communication skills- English (fluent verbal and written) and German are our working languagesAs part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from people with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.Ready to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until December 9th, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to December 2nd, 2026. are guaranteed to be considered.Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from beginning till mid of DecemberStep 3: On-site mid-end January 2027Please submit your application documents in English.Requirements- You have a Ph.D. degree in Biochemistry, Structural Biology, or Biophysics or a related area with a strong background in Protein NMR spectroscopy- You have a thorough understanding of NMR structure determination and are keen to study and compare a variety of NMR methods and build an optimized infrastructure- You have proven your skills in publications and presentations- You are experienced in cloning and expressing labeled protein targets including selective labeling- You can work independently, plan, organize, troubleshoot, present work and show innovative thinking in multidisciplinary teams- You are well organized, and have strong interpersonal and communication skills- English (fluent verbal and written) and German are our working languagesAs part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day To support the extended responsibilities of the Sales Guidance & Enablement team within Siemens Energy Grid Technologies, there is an immediate business need for a Partner Enablement Manager (f/m/d) in Germany. This role is crucial in driving structured sales guidance and enablement strategies for our global network of partners, including agents and distributors, to accelerate market reach and align with strategic growth objectives. To address this business aim, this role focuses on partner sales guidance, training program development, and performance enablement.These core areas directly support Grid Technologies' commercial success by equipping external channel partners with the necessary tools, technical-commercial knowledge, and compliance frameworks to represent our portfolio effectively. Given the focus on partner enablement and channel sales strategy, the ideal candidate will have extensive experience in partner management within the energy or industrial sector, strong communication skills, and a proven track record of designing and executing enablement programs.How You’ll Make an Impact * Develop and implement comprehensive sales guidance and enablement programs specifically tailored for indirect sales channels, including agents and distributors.* Create, update, and distribute sales toolkits, product documentation, and value proposition materials to enhance partner effectiveness.* Conduct regular workshops and training sessions (technical and commercial) to ensure partners are fully aligned with Siemens Energy Grid Technologies' portfolio and standards.* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and monitoring frameworks to evaluate partner sales performance and enablement effectiveness.* Act as the primary interface between internal sales/product teams and external partners to resolve complex enablement queries and facilitate knowledge transfer.* Support partner onboarding processes and ensure continuous compliance with Siemens Energy's business conduct guidelines and regulatory requirements.* Analyze partner feedback and market trends to continuously refine enablement strategies and identify new commercial opportunities.* Collaborate with the Innovation and Market Enablement team to align partner activities with global sales strategies and product launch roadmaps.Certifications* Certified Sales Enablement Professional (CSEP)* Project Management Professional (PMP)What You Bring* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field of study.* Several years of professional experience in partner management, channel sales, or sales enablement, preferably within the energy, grid infrastructure, or heavy industrial sectors.* Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German or other European languages is highly advantageous.* Experience in channel management, partner relationships, and sales enablement.* Strong commercial and technical understanding, including portfolio and market knowledge.* Skilled in training design, presentation, and facilitation.* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interculturaAbout the TeamOur Grid Technologies division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs
